defects.ptl-flags: the parser leaves the flags of the Std profile_tier_level at 0
defects.ptl-level: level 2.1 (general_level_idc 63) reaches the Std level enum as 6.2: the parser's table holds (uint32_t)(2.1f * 30), which is 62
defects.sps-flags: the parser leaves sps_sub_layer_ordering_info_present_flag and conformance_window_flag of the Std SPS at 0
defects.vps-dpbm: the parser sets the Std VPS pDecPicBufMgr only when the VPS has more than one sub-layer
defects.sps-strps: delta_poc_s0_minus1 and delta_poc_s1_minus1 of an SPS reference picture set hold derived POC deltas
defects.sps-hrd: every sub-layer's HRD parameters are written to sub-layer 0

adapter_defects.begin-setup-inactive: the begin-coding list names the setup picture under its target slot, which is not active yet: activation happens in the decode
adapter_defects.begin-setup-mismatch: the begin-coding list names the setup picture under its target slot, which still holds the picture it held before
adapter_defects.begin-ref-inactive: the adapter never sets StdVideoDecodeH265PictureInfo::flags.IsReference, so no decode requests reference picture setup and no slot is ever active
